This plot is only a tenth of a hectare, so I keep it close to the house and use it for something special — not my main grain fields. Because it is small, I can carry manure from our cattle to it without much trouble, and my children and I can manage most of the work ourselves. Fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and often comes late, so on such a small plot I prefer to rely on manure and maybe a small handful of DAP if I can get it. I will use the seed I saved from last year because improved seed for this crop is hard to find in our kebele.
